info.text:
Every garbage truck pays to dump. WM owns the dumps.

In 2025, WM's landfills brought in $5.3B (gross, before internal sales), next to $17.6B from collection.
Every truck pays a tipping fee to unload: the US average was $63.48 a ton in 2025 (EREF). Example: 10 tons x $63.48 = $634.80.
Haul to your own landfill and that fee stays in-house: WM did it with 69.4% of its waste in 2025 (by disposal cost), Republic Services about 67% (by volume).
WM ran 253 landfills at the end of 2025, with about 38 years of permitted space; new permits often take years.

Sources: WM FY2025 10-K and Q4 2025 results; Republic Services FY2025 10-K; EREF 2025 tipping fee analysis.
News and education, not financial advice.
